changed: In packing mode, checking a group now checks everything nested under it, and unchecking it clears them all. A group with only some of its items checked shows a dash instead of an empty box.
A group that has a weight of its own (a tent body with the poles nested under it) is something to pack in its own right, so its check covers that as well as the items inside it.
Pack progress counts the boxes you tick, so a group that only holds other items is no longer a check of its own on top of them.
